scope: Independent offline source and linked-ELF capacity review for a new 1.50.10 drawer ease variant. No hardware, installation, frozen-input mutation or inherited hardware claim.

capacity.table_change: None relative to the first drawer; wifi_recorder remains disabled. Preserve shared helper at be70.

easing.curve: Cubic ease-out over nominal 120 monotonic milliseconds; target - signed_delta * (120-elapsed)^3 / 1728000. elapsed >=120 snaps exactly to target.
easing.model_scope: Independent bounded arithmetic proof, not hardware animation or actual ELF execution.
easing.GUI_sample_quantization: Captured UP starts from preceding GUI clock_ms; fresh CLOCK after TIMER advances the first ease frame. Nominal timing can begin one GUI frame early, and observed frame rate depends on native queue and scheduling.
easing.reversal: A key request during an existing overlay starts from current cover with a fresh clock timestamp; no stale start endpoint.
easing.follow_finger: Gesture header and direct gesture.cover path are unchanged; easing runs only after gesture.active clears.
easing.new_context_field: animation_from appended at byte164 (+0xa4), preserving all prior runtime offsets.

ownership_review.touch_capture: Whole-contact capture, other-stream admission check, animation-contact suppression and physical input classification remain unchanged.
ownership_review.final_commit: Original two-GUI-scan release and publisher-locked two-ring / native display-queue-empty checks remain unchanged; final frame is successfully submitted before mode commit.
ownership_review.rendering_lifetime: Compositor and snapshot allocations remain alive. No stock submit during overlay; compositor is rewritten only when native queue is zero, then native PAN copies to staging before queue publication.
ownership_review.endpoint: The endpoint is drawn before final handoff on a subsequent drained-frame cycle; ease completion does not bypass the final input gate.
ownership_review.clock_failure: If CLOCK fails, previous clock_ms remains; interpolation does not invent elapsed time. Key recognizer cancels its partial gesture as previously.
ownership_review.bootstrap: Short-lived hook installer remains; original main is invoked once and core services retain original lifecycle.

limits: This review does not validate IRQ concurrency, native mutex implementation, all possible direct mmap writers or LCD scanout performance.
User observations for installed first drawer do not validate this new ELF/BIN, its easing feel or cold-boot behavior.
Source, ELF, BIN and review must continue to match the bound hashes; rebuilding invalidates this association.
